theorems.name: Submission.slicing_mb_lb_repr_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v → (∀ (x : Eucl P) (α : Covector (Eucl P) n), |v x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∀ η : TestFormOn U n, ENNReal.ofReal |T η| ≤ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (covectorEuclideanNorm ((η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x)) ∂μ
